property_summary: For any unconfigured prefix C created with a DAO address, a call to setDAO(newDAO) by any msg.sender must succeed and update DAO before endConfiguration(); the mutant rejects such calls from senders other than the DAO, leaving DAO unchanged, so the general rule that setDAO's success is followed by DAO() == newDAO is violated.
change_summary: Replace the guard condition so that the DAO can only be overwritten by msg.sender eq DAO (dropping the unconfigured allowance), changing when a new DAO assignment succeeds.
